**Group:** Dinoflagellates  ·  **Optics:** high-mag, low-mag

## Defining characteristics

A relatively large athecate ("naked", no armour plates) dinoflagellate that is flattened dorsoventrally, so it looks broad and leaf-like from one side and thin edge-on (taco shapped). The cingulum (girdle) is only modestly displaced, and an apical groove runs over the top of the cell. Cells lack the rigid plate pattern of armored dinoflagellates and can appear brownish from chloroplasts. Often found during mid-mitotitic division. Akashiwo sanguinea forms red tides. Key features: large size, smooth naked outline, bifricated (notched) hypocone and domed epicone.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **gyrodinium** | Both are unarmored, however Gyrodinium's cingulum is strongly displaced into an S-shaped (sigmoid), twisted girdle. |
